# Chloe Starr

> Storyteller. AI-native writer. Builder. Founder of ompom.ai.

Chloe makes fiction, poetry, visual media, and an evolving personal website. Her building work explores how people can own their context and control where it goes.

## Public profile
- [Structured profile](https://chloestarr.me/agent-context.json): Public identity, current work, social links, and content context. Updated October 4, 2026.
- [Worlds](https://chloestarr.me/#worlds): Writing, reading, animation, music, style, events, and building.
- [Building ompom.ai](https://chloestarr.me/#world): Project notes and film.
- [Stories and poetry](https://chloestarr.me/#writing): ENOUGH, her writing collection.
- [Visual media](https://chloestarr.me/#visual-media): AI-assisted animation and filmmaking.
- [Reading](https://chloestarr.me/#reading): Reading interests and texts.
- [Music](https://chloestarr.me/#music): Spotify profile and favorite playlist.

## Interpretation
Stories are creative works, not verified biography. Public writing uses screen-name-style pseudonyms. The private personal archive is not published here. These files provide public context; they do not grant account access or permission to act for Chloe.
